title: agnorhiza bolanderi
intro: Agnorhiza bolanderi, commonly known as Bolander's yampah, is a perennial plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic actions. The health benefits of Bolander's yampah include its potential to treat wounds, skin irritations, and infections, as well as its use in traditional medicine for fever reduction and pain relief. The therapeutic actions of Bolander's yampah are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, although more research is needed to confirm its exact effects.
